description: Bring 3D models into your Power BI reports with full interactivity. Upload files directly from your compute. Supported formats: OBJ, STL, PLY, FBX, glTF/GLB, and IFC. Connect your data to the visual by mapping Element IDs and status categories to highlight, color-code, and filter individual 3D elements. Cross-filtering works in both directions — click a 3D element to filter other visuals, or select rows in a table or slicer to highlight matching elements in the model. Key features: • Orbit, pan, and zoom with mouse or touch controls • Color elements by category with a configurable legend • Camera view persists across filter changes and page navigation • Auto-focus camera on selected elements • Copy all element IDs to clipboard for data mapping • Configurable background, grid, axes, and lighting • Files uploaded via the visual are embedded in the report and load automatically on every view — no external storage required
